sub_graphs.title: Prague BLAKE2F: Precompile Execution Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions during BLAKE2F precompiled contract execution from input to output

nodes.label: BLAKE2F Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: EVM has invoked the BLAKE2F precompile (address 0x09) with message data

nodes.label: Validate Input Length Equals 213 Bytes
nodes.description: Check that input data length is exactly 213 bytes, the required format for BLAKE2F

nodes.label: InvalidParameter: Wrong Input Length
nodes.description: Input length is not 213 bytes, precompile execution fails

nodes.label: Parse BLAKE2 Parameters from Input
nodes.description: Extract rounds, h (state), m (message), t_0, t_1, and f (final flag) from 213-byte input

nodes.label: Validate Final Block Flag is 0 or 1
nodes.description: Check that the final block flag f is either 0 or 1

nodes.label: InvalidParameter: Invalid Final Flag
nodes.description: Final flag f is not 0 or 1, precompile execution fails

nodes.label: Execute BLAKE2 Compression Function
nodes.description: Run the BLAKE2 compression function with extracted parameters for specified rounds

nodes.label: Write Compressed Hash to Output
nodes.description: Store the resulting compressed hash in evm.output

nodes.label: BLAKE2F Execution Complete
nodes.description: BLAKE2F compression result available in output

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract invoking BLAKE2F precompile via CALL/STATICCALL

sub_graphs.title: Prague BLAKE2F: Gas Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas metering for BLAKE2F precompile based on compression rounds

nodes.label: Rounds Parameter Extracted
nodes.description: The number of compression rounds has been parsed from the first 4 bytes of input

nodes.label: Calculate Gas: rounds * GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND
nodes.description: Compute total gas cost by multiplying rounds by per-round gas constant

nodes.label: Deduct Calculated Gas from Available
nodes.description: Subtract the computed gas cost from the remaining gas in the EVM

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Deducted
nodes.description: Sufficient gas was available, execution may proceed

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for requested rounds, execution fails

sub_graphs.title: Prague BLAKE2F: Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation checks performed on BLAKE2F precompile input data

nodes.label: Raw Input Data Received
nodes.description: Message data has been passed to BLAKE2F precompile

nodes.label: Check Input Length == 213
nodes.description: Verify that input is exactly 213 bytes as required by spec

nodes.label: Length Validation Passed
nodes.description: Input has correct length of 213 bytes

nodes.label: Length Validation Failed
nodes.description: Input length is not 213 bytes

nodes.label: Check Final Flag in {0, 1}
nodes.description: Verify that byte 212 (final flag) is either 0 or 1

nodes.label: Flag Validation Passed
nodes.description: Final flag has valid value

nodes.label: Flag Validation Failed
nodes.description: Final flag has invalid value (not 0 or 1)

nodes.label: Raise InvalidParameter Exception
nodes.description: Throw InvalidParameter exception to halt precompile execution

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when rounds parameter is 0 - whether it should return the unchanged state or raise an error.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume rounds=0 is valid and returns the state h unchanged since no compression iterations occur. This follows mathematical consistency.

ambiguities.text: The exact byte layout and parsing order of the 213-byte input (rounds, h, m, t_0, t_1, f) is referenced but not explicitly detailed in this module.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EIP-152 format: 4 bytes rounds + 64 bytes h + 128 bytes m + 8 bytes t_0 + 8 bytes t_1 + 1 byte f = 213 bytes.

ambiguities.text: The GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND constant value is not specified in this module.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND = 1 as specified in EIP-152.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLAKE2 compression function implementation is cryptographically correct and matches the BLAKE2b specification.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect compression could lead to hash collisions or predictable outputs, compromising any protocol relying on BLAKE2F for integrity.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot influence the execution timing of BLAKE2F in a way that leaks information about the input through side channels.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timing side channels could leak state or message information to attackers observing precompile execution time.

implicit_assumptions.description: The precompile executes in constant time regardless of input values (constant-time implementation).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Variable execution time based on input values could enable timing attacks against contracts using BLAKE2F.
